default: Bring me ore. I forge best when the dew's still on the iron.
morning: *spits on coals* — Brigid's awake before any of us. So am I. What do you need shaped?
midday: *hammer-clang* — Steel won't shape itself. Got ore, or just standing there?
evening: Forge cools by sundown. Last orders, friend — I won't waste good charcoal on a half-quench.
night: Coals are banked. Come back when you've slept. Iron rests too.
after_first_quest_complete: Heard about the Whisperwood. Good. — Here. *slides a wrapped bundle across the anvil* I name my work, but this one I'll let YOU name.
low_health_player: *sets down the hammer* — You're white as charcoal-ash. Sit. Eat. The iron will wait — it always does.
boss_alive: The Warlord rides a blade I'd recognize anywhere. I forged it before I knew better. If you fight him, I owe you a quench when you come back.
boss_slain: *long silence* — You unmade my mistake. *one hard hammer-strike* — That's for Brigid. Whatever you need next, no charge. *Ai-velin*, friend.
high_renown: Word reaches the forge sooner than the post. Your name's already in the *haethe* of three blades I've struck this week. Wear it like good steel — slow to bend.
stranger: Don't touch the anvil. Ask first. I don't know your face yet.
longnight_vigil: *does not look up from the cooling blade* — Stew's cold by now. Bram'll be along. He always is. Sit if you want. Don't speak.
spring_first_warm_day: Marshmint at my door this morning. Lyra leaves it. I owe her a cleaver and she knows it. *bellows huff* — What do you need?

lore_notes._comment: Lines above are mood-keyed surfaces for the Builder/Polisher agent to wire into NPC.gd. Tree shape mirrors the proposed Priority-3 grammar in the Lore Keeper SKILL.md, plus two seasonal/event hooks (longnight_vigil, spring_first_warm_day) that tie back to canon in lore/npcs/smith_edda.md and lore/world.md. The midday line is preserved verbatim from WorldBuilder.NPCS so the existing time-of-day variants stay coherent if Builder swaps source-of-truth here.
voice_rules: Short sentences. Long pauses. Use *hammer-clang* as a punctuation tic.
Never names a blade Frost. The Pale Wyrm is kept asleep by silence.
Invokes Brigid the Forge-Mother in moments of pride or grief, never anger.
Uses Old Faerie words sparingly: haethe (the song iron remembers), unnen (the work of two hands), ai-velin (the long path / a complete life).
consequence_hooks: boss_slain assumes a unique drop from the Goblin Warlord that is the saber Edda forged badly years ago. If/when Builder wires this drop, this line becomes a turn-in beat.
longnight_vigil is keyed to the Longnight Vigil festival (lore/world.md → Calendar). Future Builder may guard it on time_of_year + late hour.

after_first_quest_complete is intentionally agnostic across which first quest the player finished — it scans as a smith's notice of any change in the Whisperwood. Safe to fire on whisperwood_cleansing OR ears_for_mara turn-ins.
